install: set -euo pipefail; [ -f node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js ] || npm ci --ignore-scripts; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v codegraph >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" @colbymchenry/codegraph; if [ -f .codegraph/codegraph.db ]; then CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 codegraph sync -q; else CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 codegraph init -y --local-only; fi
